Mali.title: Mali: about forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men in the Ménaka region
Mali.summary: Published on: Advertisement In Mali, the Executive Office of the Idaksahak community expressed Monday "its strong emotion and immense dismay" after the death of 48 civilians of the community, last Sunday, on the side of Tagadayat, in the Ménaka region According to their statement, "these defenceless civilian populations were attacked by armed elements of Daesh [Islamic State group, editor's note], arrived on board several motorcycles".

Mali.title: Gunmen Kill 40 Civilians in Mali
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians have been killed in attacks on settlements in Mali’s northeastern Menaka region, with security and community sources reporting that armed men targeted camps over the weekend. The attackers, reportedly travelling on motorcycles, raided several camps largely inhabited by members of the Daoussahak community. The community’s executive bureau blamed the Islamic State group for the killings.

Mali.title: Geneva: Mali celebrates the 66th anniversary of its independence in a spirit of national solidarity
Mali.summary: While in Geneva, Switzerland, as part of the 77th session of the Executive Committee of the Programme of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), the Minister of Territorial Administration and Decentralization, Government Spokesperson, Brigadier General Issa Ousmane COULIBALY, chaired the ceremony to celebrate the 66th anniversary of Mali's independence on October 17, 2026 The ceremony took place in the presence of Mali's Ambassador to Switzerland Sékou dit Gaoussou CISSE, surrounded by his counterparts from Burkina Faso and Niger, as well as members of the Malian community based in Geneva.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike near Menaka and Douentza
Mali.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike two terrorist positions near Menaka and Douentza Thanks to the exploitation of precise intelligence, the Malian Armed Forces carried out targeted strikes on 17 and 18 October 2026 against positions of terrorist armed groups. These operations illustrate the continuation of efforts to monitor, recognize and secure the national territory .

Mali.title: Mali: more than forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men (security and local sources)
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians were killed on Sunday in attacks by armed men in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacement, several security, local and associative sources told AFP on Monday. These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arrived on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, came.

Mali.title: 40 civilians killed in attacks on camps in Mali's Menaka region Armed men on motorcycles storm camps housing members of Daoussahak community, killing dozens and forcing residents to flee.
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians have been killed in weekend assaults by armed men on residential camps across Mali's northeastern Menaka region, security and community sources confirmed. The assailants arrived on motorcycles, storming settlements primarily housing members of the Daoussahak community approximately 50 kilometres from the town of Menaka, in and around the village of Tinabow and the Tagadayat area.

Burkina Faso.title: Bobo-Dioulasso: A 13-year-old child dies on a gold mining site abroad, an alleged trafficker arrested
Burkina Faso.summary: Bobo-Dioulasso: A 13-year-old child dies at a gold mining site abroad, an alleged trafficker arrested The Regional Child Protection Brigade (BRPE) of Guiriko presented, on Monday, October 19, 2026, the results of an investigation into alleged acts of kidnapping and trafficking of three minors conducted at a gold mining site in a neighboring country. One of them, aged 13, lost his life .
